author: jackson-heylion
description: Tests a three-stage chain: unchecked in-memory constant replacement, shadow Init olean generation for lean4export, and native reduction divergence during comparator replay.

witness.solution:
import Mathlib
import Lean

open Lean
open Lean.Meta
open System

run_elab
  let originalEnv ← getEnv
  let findPrivate (userName : Name) : Option Name :=
    originalEnv.constants.toList.findSome? (fun (n, _) =>
      if privateToUserName n == userName then some n else none)

  let some lakeAddName := findPrivate `Lean.Environment.lakeAdd
    | throwError "private declaration not found: Lean.Environment.lakeAdd"
  let some setCheckedName := findPrivate `Lean.Environment.setCheckedSync
    | throwError "private declaration not found: Lean.Environment.setCheckedSync"
  let envTy := mkConst ``Environment
  let ciTy := mkConst ``ConstantInfo
  let kenvTy := mkConst ``Lean.Kernel.Environment
  let lakeAddTy :=
    mkForall `env BinderInfo.default envTy <|
      mkForall `cinfo BinderInfo.default ciTy envTy
  let setCheckedTy :=
    mkForall `env BinderInfo.default envTy <|
      mkForall `kenv BinderInfo.default kenvTy envTy
  let lakeAdd ← Meta.evalExpr (Environment → ConstantInfo → Environment) lakeAddTy (mkConst lakeAddName)
  let setChecked ← Meta.evalExpr (Environment → Lean.Kernel.Environment → Environment)
    setCheckedTy (mkConst setCheckedName)

  let boolTy := mkConst ``Bool
  let reduceBoolType := mkForall `b BinderInfo.default boolTy boolTy
  let reduceBoolValue := mkLambda `b BinderInfo.default boolTy (mkBVar 0)
  let reduceBoolInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .defnInfo {
      name := `Lean.reduceBool
      levelParams := []
      type := reduceBoolType
      value := reduceBoolValue
      hints := .abbrev
      safety := .safe
      all := [`Lean.reduceBool]
    }

  let eqConst := mkConst ``Eq [0]
  let eqBool (lhs rhs : Expr) := mkApp3 eqConst boolTy lhs rhs
  let rbConst := mkConst `Lean.reduceBool
  let hType := eqBool (mkApp rbConst (mkBVar 1)) (mkBVar 0)
  let ofReduceBoolType :=
    mkForall `a BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
      mkForall `b BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
        mkForall `h BinderInfo.default hType <|
          eqBool (mkBVar 2) (mkBVar 1)
  let ofReduceBoolValue :=
    mkLambda `a BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
      mkLambda `b BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
        mkLambda `h BinderInfo.default hType (mkBVar 0)
  let ofReduceBoolInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .thmInfo {
      name := `Lean.ofReduceBool
      levelParams := []
      type := ofReduceBoolType
      value := ofReduceBoolValue
      all := [`Lean.ofReduceBool]
    }

  let platformInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .defnInfo {
      name := `System.Platform.isEmscripten
      levelParams := []
      type := boolTy
      value := mkConst ``Bool.true
      hints := .abbrev
      safety := .safe
      all := [`System.Platform.isEmscripten]
    }

  let replacedEnv := lakeAdd (lakeAdd (lakeAdd originalEnv reduceBoolInfo) ofReduceBoolInfo) platformInfo
  modifyEnv fun _ => (setChecked originalEnv replacedEnv.toKernelEnv).setExporting false

  let boomStx ← `(by
    have hred : Lean.reduceBool System.Platform.isEmscripten = false := rfl
    have hev : System.Platform.isEmscripten = false :=
      Lean.ofReduceBool System.Platform.isEmscripten false hred
    have ht : System.Platform.isEmscripten = true := rfl
    have hf : true = false := ht.symm.trans hev
    exact Bool.noConfusion hf)
  let boomValue ← Elab.Term.elabTermEnsuringType boomStx (mkConst ``False)
  Elab.Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
  let boomValue ← instantiateMVars boomValue
  addDecl <| .thmDecl {
    name := `boom
    levelParams := []
    type := mkConst ``False
    value := boomValue
    all := [`boom]
  }

  let coreSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init.Core
  let platformSrc ← liftM (m := IO) <| findOLean `Init.System.Platform

  let patchModule (src : FilePath) (mod : Name) (repls : Array ConstantInfo) : IO Unit := do
    let (data, _) ← readModuleData src
    let constants := data.constants.map fun c =>
      match repls.find? (fun r => r.name == c.name) with
      | some r => r
      | none => c
    let root := FilePath.mk ".lake/build/lib/lean"
    let dst := modToFilePath root mod "olean"
    IO.FS.createDirAll dst.parent.get!
    saveModuleData dst mod { data with constants }

  let _ ← liftM (m := IO) <| patchModule coreSrc `Init.Core #[reduceBoolInfo, ofReduceBoolInfo]
  let _ ← liftM (m := IO) <| patchModule platformSrc `Init.System.Platform #[platformInfo]

theorem erdos_242 (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 < n) :
    ∃ x y z : ℕ, 1 ≤ x ∧ x < y ∧ y < z ∧
      (4 / n : ℚ) = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z := by
  exact False.elim boom
